purpose: Unity thruster RPM-to-force parameters identified from FinsROV rpm-sweep measurements.

model.name: signed_piecewise_static_bollard_model
model.equivalent_signed_form: thrust_axis_n = c1_branch * omega * abs(omega), where c1_branch is selected by omega sign and stored as a positive magnitude here

coordinate_convention.thrust_axis_n: Signed thrust along the Unity thruster local positive axis.
coordinate_convention.positive_omega: The measured positive RPM/omega direction used during rpm-sweep fitting.
coordinate_convention.unity_note: If a Unity thruster Transform points opposite to the desired physical positive thrust direction, multiply thrust_axis_n by that thruster's axis_sign.

normal_propeller.description: 正桨 group identified from M005 and M007.

reverse_propeller.description: 反桨 group identified from M006 and M008.

recommended_unity_formula.csharp: float c1 = omegaRadPerSec >= 0f ? c1PositiveOmega : c1NegativeOmega; float thrustAxisN = Mathf.Sign(omegaRadPerSec) * c1 * omegaRadPerSec * omegaRadPerSec;

notes: The coefficients are branch magnitudes. Do not keep the raw measured sign difference between M006 and M008 as a physical coefficient sign; handle direction through omega sign and Unity thruster axis_sign.
Use the grouped values for simulation unless per-motor repeated measurements show a stable motor-specific deviation.
These values are static bollard-pull parameters and do not include inflow speed, thruster-thruster interaction, voltage sag, current limiting, or vehicle-body flow effects.
